description:
"You have a knack for driving people crazy."

A marriage that began without love.
The distance that always existed between him and me.

"Hang in there. You've done well so far. Nothing will change."

The only person I wanted to lean on in this house was becoming a source of despair.

"...Let's get a divorce."

"I've liked Jeong-hu for a long time. Even before we got married."

He remained silent despite my belated confession. We
were living in the same space, but in different times.

The time difference between us had already grown. Could we bridge that gap?
